digest.component_or_area: live Jira DC harness tests / provenance oracle
propositions: the test asserts presence of raw Jira key via substring match against json.dumps(ticket), but the inbound path lowercases the key when deriving the local id and does not include the raw key in the ticket payload

the provenance test cannot distinguish whether a ticket was successfully created or not, making it unable to prove the headline acceptance criterion that DC issues appear in the local store after an inbound pass

the test must assert ticket id equality against the result of _jira_key_to_local_id(remote_key) instead of substring matching, and must additionally verify the binding store maps the local id to the remote key
prior test failures masked this oracle defect: an earlier run had empty store convergence, a PAT-cap bug killed setup, and only after both fixes did this unprovable assertion become visible
